common.tagline: HR and payroll for Bangladesh and beyond

home.title: One HR platform for every kind of organization
home.body: Groups of companies, factories, corporates and NGOs: core HR, attendance, leave and payroll that follow Bangladesh law out of the box.
home.trialNote: Every module for 30 days. No card needed. Your data stays yours: export it any time.

rmg.title: Garment factories
rmg.body: Lines and shifts, device attendance, overtime at twice the basic, festival bonuses by religion, and the Form 38 wage register.

corporate.title: Corporates
corporate.body: Self-service leave and payslips, salary tax worked out every month, and a provident fund that keeps itself.

ngo.title: NGOs
ngo.body: Head and field offices, staff on the move with the app, and payroll your donors can audit.

group.title: Groups of companies
group.body: Every sister concern in one workspace, with transfers that keep service and one view of the group.

law.title: Bangladesh law, built in
law.body: The Labour Act as amended in 2025 and 2026, the Income Tax Act 2023, minimum wages and the statutory registers, each rule dated and referenced.

payroll.title: Payroll that matches to the taka
payroll.body: Runs from attendance and leave, maker-checker approval, bank, bKash and Nagad files, and a parallel run against your current payroll before you switch.

attendance.title: Attendance from any device
attendance.body: ZKTeco and Hikvision devices, geofenced punching from the app, and corrections with approvals.

bangla.title: In Bangla and English
bangla.body: Every page, payslip and letter in both languages, for the factory floor and the head office.

roleDescriptions.attendance_officer: Attendance only: shifts, rosters, devices, punches and corrections, and reading the employee list (identity numbers hidden).
roleDescriptions.auditor: Reads the employee list (identity numbers hidden) and the audit log. Changes nothing.
roleDescriptions.employee: Self-service: their own profile, leave, attendance, documents and their team's approvals.
roleDescriptions.payroll_officer: Payroll: sees salaries and proposes pay changes, which someone else approves. Reads the employee list.
roleDescriptions.finance_officer: Approves pay changes made by others, sees salaries and the audit log. Changes nothing else.

gratuity.intro: What the company would owe in gratuity if every permanent employee left on the date: 30 days of the last basic for each year (a part year over six months counts), 45 once service passes ten years (s.2(10)). The change since the previous month end is the month's charge.

wppf.intro: Companies with paid-up capital of Tk 1 crore or fixed assets of Tk 2 crore set aside 5% of net profit within nine months of the year end, split 80:10:10 between the participation fund, the welfare fund and the Workers' Welfare Foundation. The participation fund is paid in equal shares to everyone of any rank (but owners and directors) employed nine months, six of them in the year; dismissed workers forfeit (Labour Act, Chapter XV).

wppf.minServiceMonthsHint: Six under the Act; fewer if the trust deed allows.

parallel.intro: Before payroll goes live, run it alongside the payroll you pay with now. Each month, compute the run here, upload the current payroll's sheet on the run page and compare. Three months in a row in which every pay group matches to the taka is the go-live test.
